meta: Content is the king, but only when you know how to write SEO-friendly blog posts. But the question is, how to write SEO-friendly blogs?
h1_text: How to write SEO friendly blog posts 2025
lede: Content is the king, but only when you know how to write SEO-friendly blog posts. But the question is, how to write SEO-friendly blogs?
copy_text: Home Blog Content Marketing How to write SEO friendly blog posts 2025 How-To Content Marketing How to write SEO friendly blog posts 2025 R Reinforce Lab team Published 1 Feb 2025 Updated 15 Apr 2025 Steps 01 What is SEO friendly blog 02 Blog without SEO- How it impacts? 03 How to write SEO friendly blog posts 04 1. Start with Keyword research 05 2. SEO friendly blog titles- Important! 06 3. Write a Perfect Introduction 07 4. Create H2, H3 & H4 Properly 08 5. Write Meta description property 09 6.Informative Contents rank better 10 7. Readability Score( How to increase readability score: Pro tips) 11 8. Originality of Content 12 9. Add Internal Links 13 10. Add External links 14 11. Optimize your feature photo 15 Never Do these things! 16 SEO like a pro 17 Wrapping Up 0 of 17 done Content is the king, but only when you know how to write SEO-friendly blog posts. But the question is, how to write SEO-friendly blogs? According to Letter.ly, 7.5 million blog posts get published every day. But how many of them get ranked? About 1% only. Now think, what about the rest of the blogs? Yes, you guessed right, they never get traffic. But writing SEO friendly blog posts can be your trump card and the only way to get traffic. Some easy and simple steps can make your content optimized for search engines. But you have to maintain all of them and do them in an accurate way. So, to give you a proper and complete guide on  how to make SEO friendly blog, we are here. Before diving into the topic, for beginners here’s an overview about what “SEO friendly blog” actually means. 1 Step 1 of 17 What is SEO friendly blog We read so many things everyday, like books, social media posts and other writings. But there are some basic differences between regular writing and web content. Web content should be optimized for search engines. But why, and how? First think about how the search engine works. When a user searches for something, an information or products, the search engine shows relevant results in the SERP page. But how does the search engine define which blog will be in the first page/search result? When you optimize your blog for search engines properly, search engine crawlers rank the page in the first page. So, An SEO friendly blog is a blog where the keywords, page, context is well optimized for search Engine. When you know how to write SEO friendly blogs, half of your task is done (other half includes technical and off page SEO). Mark step 1 done 2 Step 2 of 17 Blog without SEO- How it impacts? Blog without SEO will bring no impact on your website. Whether your target is sales, brand promotion or anything else – you need to make your content optimized. We get a question so many times: Does a blog rank without SEO? Is a blog without SEO effective? Are there any negative effects of blogs without SEO? Well, firstly, a blog can rank without doing SEO properly. But without any kind of optimization, it is quite impossible to rank and when you write about a topic in which enough content are not available, then Google ranks the content even if the content is not well optimized. A blog without SEO is not effective. Because it does not rank, does not bring traffic, does not help you to sell and ultimately your ROI will be 0. No matter how many contents your website has, it can be 10, or 100- if it is not optimized you cannot expect anything from it. When you do not know how to write SEO friendly blog posts, it may affect negatively on your site. Let me explain. When you continuously publish contents that are not ranking, search engine defines your site as less authoritative. So the site authority goes down. There is no direct negative effect like penalty, but it has far reaching impact on your website. Mark step 2 done 3 Step 3 of 17 How to write SEO friendly blog posts Mark step 3 done 4 Step 4 of 17 1. Start with Keyword research When you think about the SEO optimization in your content, the first thing you should consider is relevant keywords research. Now let me answer, Why is keyword research important for SEO? There are multiple reasons. But when your content consists of the popular keywords, search engines rank it for that query. Here is an example: Look for closure on both of the keywords. The search intent is the same in both cases, that is- looking for some tools for SEO optimized content writing. Now, if you enrich your writing with the first one, you may rank for that keyword. Even if the second keyword’s search intent is the same, this keyword is not going to help because people are not searching this way, the search volume is referring so. To learn more about it, read our following content: how to use keywords in Content? Mark step 4 done 5 Step 5 of 17 2. SEO friendly blog titles- Important! Optimized blog post includes everything, from title to meta description, you have to write everything well. Blog title is a part of on page SEO, and this SEO tips is vastly used. There are some best practices for writing SEO friendly blog titles. Here is a checklist for writing SEO friendly blog titles: Title should be within 55 characters, it is the best practice. However, there are always exceptions. There are so many Use numbers, like “10 free tools for SEO” instead of Free tools for SEO, it works better. Avoid click bites, but use existing titles, as like “Don’t miss the latest Google core updates”. The title must contain your focus keyword, and it will be better if you use it in the first part of the title. This short checklist is fine, if you follow it properly, your title can be called “SEO optimized”. It’s one of the most significant part of On-Page SEO. Mark step 5 done 6 Step 6 of 17 3. Write a Perfect Introduction The starting is a significant part of SEO, because if you cannot attract your reader in the first paragraph, the percentage of bounce rate increases. There are many suggested writing methods for introduction writing. But we will share the unique one that we use on our own. We follow some common, easy rules too, but in our own way. We use the Main keyword in the first 100 words, and we try to use it just in the first line. It works, always. After The introduction includes some data, researched based, that is a sign that your content is well researched. Avoid making internal and external links in the first paragraph, it increases the bounce rate. The introduction should contain what you are writing about, a basic overview of the topic. Mark step 6 done 7 Step 7 of 17 4. Create H2, H3 & H4 Properly There is no alternative to maintain the proper hierarchy of H2, H3, H4. Search Engine Signifies the factor very much. However there are some advance tips that you must use. The answer of how to write SEO friendly content includes the heading writing also. Here is the checklist for Heading making: Use the Title/ main keyword in H2 for once. Besides, Use the keyword in H3/H4 also in couple of times. The Heading should be relevant to the context, Do not use unnecessary headings. Use at least 1 heading in between 300 words, If you cannot use H3/h4, then use bullet point. Otherwise it affects the readability. Mark step 7 done 8 Step 8 of 17 5. Write Meta description property Meta description writing is easy, and important. Just maintain some basic rules, your meta description will be optimized. The meta description checklist is here: The meta description will be within 160 characters, and do not exceed the limit. It should contain your main keyword or focus keyword. That’s all! Follow it step by step and this will be enough. There’s no alternative to writing in an attractive way to make a position in the search engine result page (SERP), so don’t miss it. Mark step 8 done 9 Step 9 of 17 6.Informative Contents rank better Yes, this is not a regular SEO tactic, but when we are talking about quality content, there is no alternative to informative content. You may use the target keyword in the information, and it works better. Find out research and you can do your own research to give the information to the readers. Mark step 9 done 10 Step 10 of 17 7. Readability Score( How to increase readability score: Pro tips) Readability matters, the more readable your content is, the better user can relate. Remember, the reader does not come to your site to read hard research papers, they come for easy understanding information. That’s  in an easy way. Here are some pro tips about how to increase readability score. Use short sentences, do not exceed 20 words in a sentence. Do not use passive voice more than 10 percent. Use easier synonyms. Mark step 10 done 11 Step 11 of 17 8. Originality of Content Originality of a content is important because the copy content does not rank and is harmful for SEO. You may take ideas for the content from the websites or YouTube, but do not copy them, keep it original. This content strategy is significant. Mark step 11 done 12 Step 12 of 17 9. Add Internal Links Internal link building is important, because your visitors do not always come from Google search. They may come to read one article and find relevant articles, and go to it also. It helps to rank your web Contents. That creates a link of pages on your website. Mark step 12 done 13 Step 13 of 17 10. Add External links Not only your own content link, putting relevant links of your competitors can be helpful! However, not only competitors ,you can add any relevant external links as anchor text that may help the reader to understand a topic well. Mark step 13 done 14 Step 14 of 17 11. Optimize your feature photo Using relevant feature photos is important, and so many blogs miss it. There are multiple websites like freepik, where you can find photos for free. But we suggest making featured photos on your own, and we suggest using a static style for each feature photo. Mark step 14 done 15 Step 15 of 17 Never Do these things! Copy Content Keyword Stuffing Mark step 15 done 16 Step 16 of 17 SEO like a pro Best tools you may use to write SEO friendly blog : Free Tools, Paid Tools Now come to the pro tips part. I have shared how you can optimize your content for SEO. But when you want to compete with the best quality content worldwide, you need much more than just regular one. In that case, you must use tools, both free and premium. Now question on your mind, what tool should I use for content writing? Well if you want to do SEO like a pro, first you need a good keyword research tool. You can find keywords from one of the most reliable tools with updated data. Most importantly, you will get this keyword research tool free. Already curious? Yes, it is Google Keyword Planner! This is a game changing tool where you can get accurate data. Besides, there are popular premium keyword research tools. If you ask me, which keyword research tool is the best in 2024, there are several actually.  From our experience we can suggest you the top 3 (the crown belongs to the first one): SEMRush Ahrefs Uber suggest Each of them is one of the best. Yet you will get some special benefits in SEMRush. Not only keyword research, for comprehensive content writing, SEMRush is the best ever. Here is how SEMRush can help you to find how to write good blogs for SEO. You can create a content template in a couple of minutes using the tool. With template, you can see the semantically related keywords that you should include in your content. You can find your competitors, and from where you can get backlinks. It will suggest the content length as well. The template includes the reading materials, so that you do not need to put effort on searching things all over the internet. Now you can ask, Is SEMRush Enough? Yes, it is enough for optimization but you may need some other tools as a writer, to make your content better. As like, grammar and plagiarism checkers. Grammar Checking tools : Grammatical mistakes create a bad impression, but to err is human. So, using a grammar checker is a safe option. There are both paid and free grammar checkers. In recent years, the best grammar checker is grammarly. If you are looking for a free one, go for ProWritingAid. Plagiarism Checker tools: To check originality, you must use a premium tool. This is highly recommended because from my real experience I always get disappointed by free plagiarism checkers. So go for premium checkers. In recent years, the best plagiarism checkers are copyscape and quetext. You can use any of them. AI generated Content : Should you use it? Nowadays, its a popular question. Should I use AI generated contents? Because they are ranking! Well, AI was made to make our life easier and better. In every case, it’s the same. Writing content with manual effort is time consuming, needs attention and research. On the other hand, when you use AI, you can do these works even in a minute. So here you can ask the question, is AI a better option than manual SEO friendly writing? There are some pros and cons of AI generated content. Read them and decide on your own if you should use AI or not. Pros of AI: Less time consuming 100% Grammar accuracy and tone Works well on creating informative posts Cons of AI: AI generated contents are not in depth, and they just sum up the available information on the internet. This is a Threat to the quality of SERP pages, because users often won’t get accurate news or related things. AI generated review blogs are fake in true sense. Without proper guidance, even AI cannot write content that is good enough for SEO. Most of the time, AI generated content does not rank, because of its low quality. There are only a few AI software available that provides good quality writing. So, our suggestion will always be: Mix both. Well this opinion may sound contradictory to so many SEO experts. But we believe technology is not our enemy, they makes our life easier. So if you already know how to do SEO like a pro and how to write SEO friendly blog, then AI will make your task easier. Its just a complementary helping hand, not alternative to human. Mark step 16 done 17 Step 17 of 17 Wrapping Up The process is easy, yet you have to make sure that you are following all the steps in a proper way. When you know how to write good blogs for SEO, the possibility of ranking is the highest. We started the blog with the line, content is the king, and do not forget to utilize this chance. You cannot always maintain the other factors about SEO, because SEO is a mysterious puzzle. But when you know how to make an SEO friendly blog, your task becomes much easier because writing content maintaining the optimization factors is the easiest option ever. title: 5 Best Ideas for Personal Website Content 2025-Reinforce Lab Ltd.
meta: Having creative ideas for personal website content can go a long way to progress your career as a website is more unique than a CV or resume.
h1_text: Best 5 Ideas for Personal Website Content 2025
lede: About 10 min in total
copy_text: Home Blog Web Design Best 5 Ideas for Personal Website Content 2025 Guide Web Design Best 5 Ideas for Personal Website Content 2025 R Reinforce Lab team Published 3 Feb 2025 Updated 15 Apr 2025 12 Chapters 10 Min read 01 What is a Personal Website? 2 min 02 Ideas for Personal Website Content 1 min 03 Homepage 1 min 04 About Page 1 min 05 Contact Info 1 min 06 Portfolio 1 min 07 Resume 1 min 08 Professional Blogs 1 min 09 Testimonials 1 min 10 Case Studies 1 min 11 What type of Content to Avoid for A Personal Website? 1 min 12 Wrapping Up – Ideas for Personal Website Content 1 min Chapter 01 of 12 0% read Chapters 0% 01 What is a Personal Website? 02 Ideas for Personal Website Content 03 Homepage 04 About Page 05 Contact Info 06 Portfolio 07 Resume 08 Professional Blogs 09 Testimonials 10 Case Studies 11 What type of Content to Avoid for A Personal Website? 12 Wrapping Up – Ideas for Personal Website Content About 10 min in total Having creative ideas for personal website content can go a long way to progressing your career, as a website is more unique than a CV or resume. Whether you are hunting for work, trying to run a business, or selling a product, a website of your own can provide you with a healthy online presence and more credibility. Anyone can open a page on a social media platform or business/employment platforms that are readily available. However, having your own website would indicate that you are more serious. So with all the business and industry websites around us, let’s get to know about – 01 Chapter 1 · 2 min What is a Personal Website? A personal website is a website created to showcase an individual’s work and persona. Unlike the majority of internet web pages, it does not pertain to any particular corporation, institution, or organization. You can denote it as a group of web pages where only your personal features, works, achievements, and contact information will be. Additionally, it lets you showcase your work in your creative structure. WorkItDaily states that nearly 56% of employers and recruiters are more impressed by an individual’s website. On the other hand, according to Forbes , only 7% of the general population has a personal website. For millennials, the percentage is 15%. Of course, the percentages have increased by today. Nonetheless, it indicates that a personal website can give you a great chance to stand out from the crowd. Having a personal website might sound difficult at first, however, once you get the hang of it, it is pretty straightforward. Furthermore, when you develop some personal website content ideas and implement them in a well-planned way, it creates a beautiful online presence for you. To implement that more effectively, you can look into some simple personal website examples for ideas. You will be able to see how creatively people have already managed to showcase their features. Usually, you will find many colorful and vibrant features in their web content design. Moreover, if you are more serious about your work and focusing on a professional presence, you can look into some professional personal website examples. Checking these out will give you a more in-depth idea about web content personalization in a more professional manner. At the end of the day, you want to create a healthy online presence and attract people who are more aligned or appreciative of your work. Your personal website design and personal website content allow you to do just that. It is a great source of personal branding. With those in mind, we are here to provide you with some amazing ideas for personal website content. End of chapter 1 Next: Ideas for Personal Website Content → 02 Chapter 2 · 1 min Ideas for Personal Website Content The more decorated, organized, and personalized your personal website content is, the more attractive it will feel. You will even feel good about yourself when your website is full of quality content. So, with a focus on web content personalization, here are the sections and content you must have on your website for proper optimization. End of chapter 2 Next: Homepage → 03 Chapter 3 · 1 min Homepage Your website homepage should greet people according to your persona and profession. Decorate your homepage with your signature style, font, and colors. If your homepage layout is strong, so will your website. Personal websites do not need a lot of links and sub-links. We will explain which sections and pages will add more to your website. However, make it so that your homepage itself will catch the eyes of the hiring managers. Add attractive feature photos of you or content related to you. You can also include an image of your workstation if you make it visually organized and pleasing. Look out for the color scheme. Choosing an aesthetically pleasing color scheme for your website will highly appeal to the visual memory of your potential clients. Include your elevator pitch statement on your homepage. It means mentioning your passion, profession, and goal in your way. On your homepage, do it as shortly and impactfully as possible. This, when done effectively, will lead your visitors to be interested to learn more about you. Needless to say, your homepage is the most integral part of your personal website design. It will define the template of your website and lead site visitors to more of your personalized website content. End of chapter 3 Next: About Page → 04 Chapter 4 · 1 min About Page Having a crafty, short, and sweet About page will give people just what they need. An idea of you and your work. Oftentimes, it would be the home page or landing page of your website, so make a good first impression. Don’t make the mistake of making your about page too long. It may have worked in the early stages on the internet. In today’s day and age, just having a short greeting, having a bit of personal touch, and showcasing your work and background would be enough. Just feature these: What do you work on Your educational/professional background A mentionable work achievement Your latest project and current passion All these pieces of information can make your About Page good to go. This page is another sector where you are endorsing your elevator pitch. So, make your passion and profession known to your site visitors. Let them know what you are looking for and aiming for. All these can make your about page much stronger. End of chapter 4 Next: Contact Info → 05 Chapter 5 · 1 min Contact Info So now that people know about you, where can they contact you, or how can they hire you? It is essential to let people connect with you and contact you. In that regard, attach your email and contact number if you feel comfortable. Link your social or professional profiles as required. It is a good idea to attach appropriate icons with the contacts. This makes the contact content look more familiar, professional, and attractive. A great piece of content you can create for your website is a contact form. People can leave text messages directly there or if they have any inquiries. It is always best to let people choose multiple options to contact you. Whether they want to email you, text you, or contact you directly, they should have the option. So craft your contact information content section accordingly. End of chapter 5 Next: Portfolio → 06 Chapter 6 · 1 min Portfolio Your portfolio will need to feature your best work samples. This gives your viewer a hands-on experience of your work. Visual content creator like graphic designers or photo/video editors can make their best impression in this sector. So, if you are a graphic designer or editor, do not forget to put in your best work here to showcase to the world. If you are a content writer or web developer, you can link your best articles and web pages here. If you send your website to your possible employers, this is where they would focus most. So it is very necessary to make your personal website’s portfolio section well-crafted and organized. End of chapter 6 Next: Resume → 07 Chapter 7 · 1 min Resume Forwarding a regular resume through email or hand-to-hand has become a common experience nowadays. However, if you pass your website to your potential client or employer, it creates a different experience when they see your resume on your website. You can take help from resume websites. From there, you can easily form and share your resume using proper templates. Make sure these sections are visible in your resume: Your education/ qualifications Your skillsets and expertise Your work experiences Your notable achievements These pieces of content are very necessary for your resume, which adds to your site too. Usually, you would add specific changes to your resume according to the need of the job you are applying for. Since on your website, anyone from any sector can visit your resume, you can make your resume a bit more elaborate. Try to include all your noteworthy educational and professional qualifications in your resume so that it can seem multipurpose and cover multiple grounds. End of chapter 7 Next: Professional Blogs → 08 Chapter 8 · 1 min Professional Blogs Blogs should be included in your personal website content ideas. Blogs contain a lot of useful information and, if presented well, also generate a lot of traffic. So whether you write your article or feature some blog articles related to your profession, it would surely enrich your personal website and make it look well-established. Link your WordPress with your website. Learn how to function and operate WordPress well. Through that, you will easily be able to process, update, write, and re-write articles to your liking. People regularly visit blogs for updates, tips, information, and fun. So when you have well-crafted, relevant, and engaging blogs on your website, your personal website quality and viewership will automatically skyrocket. People often comment in blog comment sections. Look after those. Interact with them, and you will also find possible new ideas for newer content. End of chapter 8 Next: Testimonials → 09 Chapter 9 · 1 min Testimonials Positive word of mouth is always a plus for any personal or business venture. When clients or employers check your website and see authentic reviews and words from people who have worked with you or people you have worked for, it is sure to create a positive impact. Beyond what you write about yourself, if people agree that you have a strong work ethic, you are skilled and expert in your sector, and all the related adjectives relevant to your sector, it can give you increased credibility. To garner authentic testimonials, you can ask your formal clients and or employers to mention a brief comment about yourself and how helpful your work or skillset has been. If they struggle to write properly, use a formal LinkedIn comment that goes with you and ask for their approval or modification. All in all, testimonials are surely very useful among your ideas for personal website content. Again I emphasize that to increase your marketing effectiveness and draw in more customers via online channels, SEO helps other digital marketing techniques on a large scale. The bottom line is SEO is a beneficial investment for small businesses aiming to expand and prosper in the digital era. copy_text: Home Blog Search Engine Optimization Latest SEO update 2025 : 14 Search Engine… Update Search Engine Optimization Latest SEO update 2025 : 14 Search Engine Updates R Reinforce Lab team Published 9 Feb 2025 Updated 15 Apr 2025 Do you know the latest SEO updates for 2025? How often do Search Engine Updates occurs? or when for natural google update SEO or google local SEO update? For Search Engine updates, you are in the right place. We often get questions, how often does google update SEO? According to Search Engine Land, in 2025. Google came up with 3 core updates and 2 product review updates ( one of them is on 1st December). But that’s not all. The answer to How often Google updates SEO is- 500/600 times per year. Though not all of them are significant updates, acknowledging them is essential for SEO strategy. Search engines bring various changes that are connected to SEO and ranking factors. There is no alternative to staying updated with the latest news and changes in search engines. That is why we make your task easier by posting the monthly updates together. We have gathered all the search engine updates for December 2025. Let’s see what they are: Latest SEO Update 2025: 14 Search Engine Updates In December month, there were 14 mentionable updates. Here they are sorted by date: 1. Product Review Updates On 1st December 2024, google brought a new update on product reviews. This google algorithm update SEO is for affiliate marketers and significantly impacts SEO and blog post writing style. Google puts emphasis on genuine reviews that actually help the consumers, not only structured data. Must avoid intrusive interstitials. They suggested focusing on two points: 1. Add proof to your review 2. Add More than 1 seller 2. Shopping integration with photoshop On 2nd December Google announced that they would integrate with Photoshop. Previously, you had to use Google merchant center to show products on search results. This was a little bit of a complicated process. From this update, you can easily upload your products. 3. Google Ads API update On 3rd December, Google ads API announced that it would support recommendations, performance max campaigns and keyword planners. But these tools are not going to be free, as the way Google API Isn’t. For every 25,000 operations, it charges one dollar. 4. Political Content Policy Update On 6th December, Google updated its political content policy, which will be activated from 15th February. One of the mentionable changes is that political content will be no more national. You can select your target audience worldwide. 5. Image extension Update On 7th December, Google launched an image extension for desktops as well. Previously this was only for mobile phones. However, this update launched in the USA a few months ago, and finally, it started worldwide. 6. Ethical shopping hub Launch On 8th December, Microsoft launched an ethical shopping hub. Previously it was only available for the UK region, but now everyone can use the Facility. 7. Google Map change On 10th December,  Google Changed the map for local searches. Though the change is so tiny, it improves the user experience for map search queries. 10. Product Entity Update On 28th December, Google announced a change in product entity evaluation in the Google search console. lede: Robots.txt tells search engines and AI crawlers which parts of your site they may crawl. What it does, what it cannot do, how to write one and how to test it.
copy_text:
Home Blog Search Engine Optimization Robots.txt for SEO: A Complete Guide Guide Search Engine Optimization Robots.txt for SEO: A Complete Guide Robots.txt tells search engines and AI crawlers which parts of your site they may crawl. What it does, what it cannot do, how to write one and how to test it. J Jamil Ahmed Published 29 Jan 2025 Updated 12 Nov 2026 11 Chapters 8 Min read A to Z Glossary 01 What is a robots.txt file? 1 min 02 Why is robots.txt important for SEO? 1 min 03 What can robots.txt not do? 1 min 04 What does a robots.txt file look like? 1 min 05 How do you create a robots.txt file? 2 min 06 Robots.txt examples you can copy 1 min 07 What are the most common robots.txt mistakes? 1 min 08 Robots.txt best practices 1 min 09 Robots.txt and AI crawlers 1 min 10 Robots.txt or a meta robots tag: which one? 1 min 11 Wrapping up 1 min Chapter 01 of 11 0% read Chapters 0% 01 What is a robots.txt file? 02 Why is robots.txt important for SEO? 03 What can robots.txt not do? 04 What does a robots.txt file look like? 05 How do you create a robots.txt file? 06 Robots.txt examples you can copy 07 What are the most common robots.txt mistakes? 08 Robots.txt best practices 09 Robots.txt and AI crawlers 10 Robots.txt or a meta robots tag: which one? 11 Wrapping up About 8 min in total Short answer A robots.txt file is a plain text file at the root of your website that tells search engine and AI crawlers which pages and files they may crawl. It manages crawling, not indexing: to keep a page out of Google, use a noindex tag or a password instead. 01 Robots.txt controls which parts of your site crawlers may open. It lives at the root, such as example.com/robots.txt. 02 It does not keep a page out of Google. A blocked page can still be indexed if other sites link to it. 03 Google supports four fields: User-agent, Disallow, Allow and Sitemap. It ignores crawl-delay. 04 Each subdomain needs its own file, and Google reads only the first 500 kibibytes. 05 AI crawlers such as OAI-SearchBot and GPTBot follow robots.txt too, so decide on purpose whether to allow them. 06 Test the file in a private browser window and in the robots.txt report in Search Console after every change. A robots.txt file is a small text file that tells search engines which parts of your website they may crawl. It sits at the root of your site, for example https://example.com/robots.txt . Every well-behaved crawler reads it before it looks at anything else. This guide explains what the file does, what it cannot do, how to write one, and how to check it. Every rule here comes from Google’s own documentation, which is linked at the end. 01 Chapter 1 · 1 min What is a robots.txt file? A robots.txt file is a plain text file with rules for web crawlers. A crawler is the program a search engine uses to read web pages. Search engine crawlers are also called bots or spiders. Googlebot is Google’s crawler. Bingbot is Bing’s. Each rule says which crawler it is for and which paths that crawler may or may not open. Rules are also called directives. Google says the file is used mainly to manage crawler traffic, so your server is not overloaded with requests. The rules follow a standard called the Robots Exclusion Protocol. If a site has no robots.txt file, crawlers assume they may crawl everything. End of chapter 1 Next: Why is robots.txt important for SEO? → 02 Chapter 2 · 1 min Why is robots.txt important for SEO? Search engines do not have unlimited time for your site. SEO people call that time your crawl budget. Robots.txt helps crawlers spend it on the pages that matter. It keeps crawlers out of pages with no search value. Think of admin screens, cart pages and internal search results. The same goes for pages that are near copies of each other (duplicate content), such as filtered product lists. It protects your server. On a large site, crawlers can make many requests. Rules reduce that load. It can keep media files out of Google. Google says you can use it to stop images, video and audio files from showing in search results. It points crawlers to your sitemap. One line tells them where the list of your important pages is. A mistake here can also do real harm. One wrong line can block your entire site from being crawled. That is why this file deserves care. End of chapter 2 Next: What can robots.txt not do? → 03 Chapter 3 · 1 min What can robots.txt not do? This is the part most guides get wrong, so read it twice. Robots.txt does not keep a page out of Google. It stops crawling. It does not stop indexing. Google says a blocked page can still appear in search results if other pages link to it. The result will show the address with no description. To keep a page out of search results, Google tells you to use one of these instead: a noindex tag or header on the page a password on the page removing the page Do not combine a noindex tag with a block in robots.txt. If the crawler cannot open the page, it never sees the noindex tag. Robots.txt is not security. The file is public. Anyone can read it. Google also notes that some crawlers do not obey it. Private files need a password, not a line in a text file. End of chapter 3 Next: What does a robots.txt file look like? → 04 Chapter 4 · 1 min What does a robots.txt file look like? Here is a simple file with two groups of rules and a sitemap line. User-agent: Googlebot
Disallow: /nogooglebot/

User-agent: *
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml In plain words: Googlebot may not crawl any address that starts with /nogooglebot/ . Every other crawler may crawl the whole site. The sitemap is at the address shown. Google supports four fields in this file: Field What it does Example User-agent Names the crawler the rules are for. A star means all crawlers. User-agent: * Disallow A path the crawler must not open. Disallow: /cart/ Allow A path the crawler may open, even inside a blocked folder. Allow: /cart/help/ Sitemap The full address of your sitemap. Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml Google does not support crawl-delay . Lines it does not understand are ignored. End of chapter 4 Next: How do you create a robots.txt file? → 05 Chapter 5 · 2 min How do you create a robots.txt file? Google describes four steps: create the file, add rules, upload it, and test it. 1. Create a file named robots.txt Use a plain text editor such as Notepad or TextEdit. Do not use a word processor. Word processors can add hidden characters and curly quotes that break the rules. Save the file as robots.txt in UTF-8 format. The name must be exactly that, in lower case. A site can have only one. 2. Choose the user agent Every group of rules starts with a User-agent line. It says who the rules are for. One crawler: User-agent: Googlebot Several crawlers: put each name on its own line above the same rules. All crawlers: User-agent: * A crawler follows only one group: the one that names it most exactly. If there is a group for Googlebot and a group for * , Googlebot follows its own group and ignores the other. The order of the groups in the file does not matter. 3. Add your rules Under the user agent, add one rule per line. Each path starts with a slash. A folder ends with a slash too. User-agent: *
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php
Disallow: /?s= Three things to remember: Paths are case-sensitive. /File.pdf and /file.pdf are different. A star is a wildcard. It stands for any text in a path. A line that starts with # is a comment. Use comments to say why a rule exists. 4. Upload the file to the root of your site The file must sit in the root directory, the top level of your site, such as https://www.example.com/robots.txt . Crawlers do not look for it in a folder. The file only covers the exact site it is on. Rules on https://example.com do not apply to https://shop.example.com . Each subdomain needs its own file. On some website builders, such as Wix or Blogger, you may not be able to edit the file yourself. Google says to use the platform’s own search settings in that case. On WordPress, SEO plugins such as Yoast SEO let you edit it from the dashboard. 5. Test it and keep it up to date First, open the file in a private browser window. If you can see your rules, crawlers can too. Then open the robots.txt report in Google Search Console. Google lists it as the way to find and fix problems in a file that is already live. Check the file again after every site change, launch or migration. Google usually keeps a copy for up to 24 hours, so a change may take a day to be picked up. End of chapter 5 Next: Robots.txt examples you can copy → Reinforce Lab service · Technical SEO Not sure what your robots.txt is blocking? Reinforce Lab finds what stops search engines and AI crawlers from reading your pages, fixes it, and re-crawls to prove it. See technical SEO services → Or get a free diagnostic first 06 Chapter 6 · 1 min Robots.txt examples you can copy These are the rules most sites need. Change the paths to match your own site. Allow everything User-agent: *
Disallow: An empty Disallow line blocks nothing. This has the same effect as having no file at all. Block one folder User-agent: *
Disallow: /checkout/ Every address that starts with /checkout/ is off limits to all crawlers. Block a folder but allow one file in it User-agent: *
Disallow: /downloads/
Allow: /downloads/price-list.pdf The more exact rule wins, so the price list can still be crawled. Block one type of file User-agent: *
Disallow: /*.xls$ The star stands for any text. The dollar sign marks the end of the address. Together they match every address that ends in .xls . Block one crawler only User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: *
Allow: / Here one named crawler is kept out and all others are welcome. Add your sitemap Sitemap: https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml Use the full address. You can list more than one sitemap, each on its own line. End of chapter 6 Next: What are the most common robots.txt mistakes? → 07 Chapter 7 · 1 min What are the most common robots.txt mistakes? Blocking the entire site. The directive Disallow: / under User-agent: * stops all crawling. This is often left over from a test site. Using it to hide pages. Blocked pages can still be indexed. Use noindex instead. Blocking files a page needs. Google warns against blocking style and script files if the page is hard to understand without them. Putting the file in a folder. It only works at the root. Forgetting subdomains. Each one needs its own file. Letting the file break. If your server returns an error for robots.txt, Google stops crawling the site for the first 12 hours. It then uses the last good copy for up to 30 days. Making it too big. Google reads only the first 500 kibibytes. End of chapter 7 Next: Robots.txt best practices → 08 Chapter 8 · 1 min Robots.txt best practices Keep the file short. Fewer robots.txt rules mean fewer mistakes. Block sections, not single pages. Use one rule for a folder where you can. Add the sitemap directive. It helps crawlers find your important pages. Write a comment above each rule. Say why it is there, so the next person does not have to guess. Check Search Console. A page marked as blocked by robots.txt there should be one you meant to block. Review the file after every launch or migration. Test sites often carry a rule that blocks everything. End of chapter 8 Next: Robots.txt and AI crawlers → 09 Chapter 9 · 1 min Robots.txt and AI crawlers AI tools read the web too, and each one has its own crawler name. You can allow or block them in robots.txt like any other crawler. Crawler name Who runs it What it is for OAI-SearchBot OpenAI Showing sites in ChatGPT search answers GPTBot OpenAI Collecting content that may be used to train its models Google-Extended Google Controls use of your content for Gemini training and grounding Two facts matter here. OpenAI says sites that block OAI-SearchBot will not be shown in ChatGPT search answers. Google says Google-Extended does not affect your place in Google Search. So decide on purpose. If you want AI answers to name and cite your business, do not block the search crawlers. End of chapter 9 Next: Robots.txt or a meta robots tag: which one? → 10 Chapter 10 · 1 min Robots.txt or a meta robots tag: which one? They do different jobs. Use the one that fits the goal. Your goal Use this Stop crawlers wasting time on a section Robots.txt Keep one page out of search results A noindex meta tag Keep an image or video file out of search results Robots.txt Keep a PDF out of search results A noindex header Keep something private A password Robots.txt works on whole sections of a site. A meta robots tag works on one page at a time. End of chapter 10 Next: Wrapping up → 11 Chapter 11 · 1 min Wrapping up Robots.txt is short, but it controls how every crawler meets your site. Keep it simple. Block only what has no search value. Never use it to hide pages. Test it after every change. If your pages are not being crawled or indexed and you are not sure why, the robots.txt file is the first place to look. It is also the first thing our technical SEO services check. To see how AI tools find and cite a site, read about AI search optimization . Back matter Glossary A to Z C Crawler A program a search engine or AI tool uses to read web pages. Also called a bot or spider. D Disallow A rule that tells a crawler not to open a path. N Noindex A tag or header that tells search engines not to show a page in results. S Sitemap A file that lists the pages you want search engines to find. U User agent The name a crawler gives itself, such as Googlebot. Rules in robots.txt are addressed to user agents. Questions FAQs Do I need a robots.txt file? Not always. Without one, crawlers assume they may crawl the whole site. A small site with no private or duplicate sections can work without it. Most sites still add one to block admin pages and point to the sitemap. Can robots.txt remove a page from Google? No. It only stops crawling. Google says a blocked page can still appear in results if other pages link to it. To remove a page, use a noindex tag, a password, or delete the page. Where should I put my robots.txt file? At the root of the site it is for, such as https://www.example.com/robots.txt. Crawlers do not look for it in folders. Each subdomain needs its own file. How long do robots.txt changes take to work? Google usually keeps a copy of the file for up to 24 hours. So a change can take about a day to be noticed. OpenAI also says its search systems can take about 24 hours to adjust. What happens if robots.txt returns an error? If the file is missing (a 404 error), Google treats the site as having no crawl limits. If the server fails (a 5xx error), Google stops crawling the site for the first 12 hours, then uses the last good copy for up to 30 days. What is the maximum size of a robots.txt file? Google reads the first 500 kibibytes of the file. Anything after that is ignored. If your file is close to that size, combine rules or move blocked content into one folder. Should I block AI crawlers in robots.txt? It depends on your goal. Blocking OAI-SearchBot keeps your site out of ChatGPT search answers. Blocking GPTBot or Google-Extended only limits use of your content for AI training. If you want AI tools to cite you, allow the search crawlers. Does Google support crawl-delay in robots.txt? No. Google lists crawl-delay as a field it does not support. Google supports User-agent, Allow, Disallow and Sitemap. copy_text: Home Blog Digital Marketing Sensory Marketing: Know How 5 Senses Marketing Works… Explainer Digital Marketing Sensory Marketing: Know How 5 Senses Marketing Works Best for Businesses R Reinforce Lab team Published 20 Feb 2025 Updated 13 Apr 2025 Sensory marketing or sensory appeal is one of the effective methods of advertising where the 5 senses marketing approach is applied mainly. Sensory market research seeks to understand consumers’ views of a product and their whole experience. According to Science of Sensory Marketing , a certain sensory appeal can alter how a person views an object or activity when connected with that sensory experience. So, a sensory marketing strategy can be one of the best choices. As marketing is increasing, trying marketing that plays with people’s senses can help you keep ahead for sure. I know this sensory appeal sounds quite unorthodox, but trust me, things will be much easier once you understand its algorithm. For your business at the same time, for your potential customers for sure! As a marketer, you should apply various marketing techniques to see which is suitable for your business, right? Here you will get another sensational marketing technique; you can say, called sensory branding or marketing. So let’s get started then! What Is Sensory Marketing? Most individuals may be unfamiliar with this notion and wonder, “What is sensory marketing?” Although there are several methods for sense marketing definition, the sensory marketing concept remains consistent. Simply said, marketing with sense is the implementation of a marketing plan with emotional connections that appeal to customers. Sense marketing’s definition appeals to the five senses of the audience: sight, sound, touch, taste, and smell. The marketing tool of sensory marketing entails a variety of ways to reach your customers’ senses. And they are influencing their behavior depending on how your brand and tactics make them feel aside from traditional marketing. Using media senses in advertising and marketing campaigns may significantly impact your audience for your product or service. Also, their choice to purchase your goods is how sensorial emotional appeal works. Like sense marketing definition, now see something directly connected with this sensorial emotional appeal! Five Senses Sensory Marketing are – Marketers use marketing with senses to catch their target audiences more perfectly. Obviously, marketing with sense helps a lot in retargeting your potential consumers as its effects are intense emotional connections. Five senses of sensory marketing that marketing use as a marketing tool in its best ways are – 1. Sensory Marketing with Sight Here marketers attract consumers with unique or brand-related – Colors Images Text Graphics Video Light In this way, they properly use the sense marketing definition. 2. Sensory Marketing With Sounds Using this type of sense can attract consumers most and marketers use – Voice Overs Sound Effects Thematic Music To let consumers know about a specific brand so that they can remember faster after hearing that tune or music anywhere anytime. 3. Sensory Marketing With Scent Smelling works best in case of memorizing anything and brands use this option much fruitfully with – Environmental Scents Fragrances Food Scents The more unique smell the more brand awareness you can get and this is how marketing with scent works. 4. Sensory Marketing with Touch Touching sense can be remembered years after years so marketers never fail to use this sensory marketing tactic. Marketing with touch does not mean you will have to allow your products for touching randomly, instead, it works with – Comfort Collateral Hands-On Tests So people can simply judge w2hat they are offering in person and trust me this system, works best! 5. Sensory Marketing with Taste People’s sense of taste with taste buds is the best thing that you can use for your promotions. And how do marketers usually do that? See the ways – Samples New Flavors This way people can get the varieties in their product selection which helps them to see what they should choose. Why Is Sensory Marketing Important? There are thousands of reasons available for your business to define it as a sensory marketing brand. But for that, you must apply a suitable sensory branding strategy; otherwise, it will not work. Here are 5 reasons why sensory testing is essential! 01. Sensory marketing is a go-to approach since it is all about improving the consumer experience This sort of marketing mainly plays with the senses of the audience. So this marketing approach includes things that can give comfort to audiences. As a result, consumers absorb more of this type of marketing method. Ultimately businesses with sensory marketing can improve the consumer experience. 02. Mainly, the sensory appeal offers a whole experience Sensory marketing brands take the advantage of people’s 5 senses. So ultimately they can easily win people’s hearts if the approach can be applied perfectly at the same time uniquely. Offering marketing methods including satisfying customers’ 5 senses can work better than any other technique. That is why it is one of the biggest important issues to go for this theory as it gives the whole experience to any consumer. 03. It can stand out as a distinctively engaging method of capturing the audience’s attention While blending marketing sense with people’s emotions can easily catch people’s attention. If you know the proper strategy and how things work in this marketing method then things will be easier enough. Trust me marketing brands of sensory appliances use this method in order to get much engagement and they became succeeded. So if you can get proper ideas on how sensory marketing works nothing can stop your business! 04. Build the relationship between brand and consumer by exciting all the senses and producing emotions Customers want to interact with businesses that do good or make them feel good and also sense of taste good. And you can simply make them feel something by using sensory marketing. Customers who are emotionally committed to a brand are less likely to switch to a competitor brand. You’ve gained their trust and will be rewarded with higher client retention. 05. Sensory Ads text with multisensory stimulation improves genuine taste judgments Consumers’ senses are aroused when they can eat, smell, or listen to your sensory appeal; Following sense marketing definition, the brain combines information from these many sensory inputs guarantees. That the tasting experience with a sense of taste is always multimodal. As a result, consumers can readily sense how your offerings are as marketing experts. And they will remain loyal to your business regardless of what happens. Brands that Employ Sensory Marketing Examples Companies that use sensory marketing in their branding strategies never fail to tempt their target audiences, which is a thousand times true. Let’s learn about some examples used by marketing experts that will surely realize how effective sensory marketing is! So starting with – Apple Customers may interact with the company through very immersive in-store experiences. The stores, which are decked in Apple’s distinctive white, are a visual feast, All of their retail stores or shops are crammed with products you can touch, play with, and experience. Apple stores are an essential aspect of Apple’s sensory marketing approach. As well as a sense of marketing definition to expose people to the lifestyle Apple gadgets promote. MASTERCARD Mastercard is leveraging sensory appeal to establish a new identity for credit card users — the “sonic identity,” to be precise. When a customer completes a transaction, they hear the sonic sound. The sound is intended to represent the meeting of the red and yellow circles in Mastercard’s logo. That noise creates a sense of security and consistency – because of the familiar sound, customers know their transactions were successful. Customers can nevertheless get a fictitious visual experience. Marriott Hotels Marriott Hotels employed a virtual reality headset to transport its guests to holiday places where Marriott has a presence. By allowing them to see famous spots as well as experience odors and noises connected with the area. VR and AR bring a visual layer to marketing, which is critical for companies but much more appeal to customers. It takes a visual or text ad and enhances it in such a manner that it becomes more interactive and tailored for customers or clients. Using an AR app can assist clients in deciding whether they want to visit this place in person and use Marriott as a service provider. So you easily guess how this aside from traditional marketing this sort of marketing works for businesses to grow flawlessly, right? I know you can! Now let’s see how going into a sensory experience can help in Sensory Marketing – Know-How 5 Senses Marketing Works Best for Businesses 1. Blend Marketing Sense with Emotional Activities Emotions are more important in marketing now than ever before. If you want your clients to believe in your brand, you must first create an emotional appeal to them. Airbnb, for example, does this brilliantly with its “Belong Anywhere” marketing. Consider this: the deeper you can connect emotionally with your readers, the they will likely remember your brand. This, in turn, will allow you to appeal to their other media senses as well. 2. Recreate Advertising with a Sense of Smell In South Korea, Dunkin’ Donuts employed sensory marketing by releasing a coffee fragrance into the air while playing their business jingle. Even if this sounds a little far-fetched for your company, there are still techniques to appeal to your clients’ sense of scent. Placement of scented advertisements in major publications and the use of a signature fragrance in your businesses are two clever possibilities. Smell is a strong sense, and studies have shown that pleasant fragrances may boost mood by 40%. Find a way to include smell in your brand to stick with the sense marketing definition. However, when employing scent in your advertising, be sure that the aroma is not overpowering. While fragrance has the ability to evoke happy memories, it also has the ability to repel your audience. I approached this feeling with caution and purpose. 3. Include Sound Effects in Senses Marketing In advertising, sound may take numerous forms. It may be the State Farm jingle “Like a nice neighbor…” or a catchphrase you can’t get out of your brain. Today, sensory advertising necessitates that all firms and retail stores use sound in their branding initiatives. If something appears tough, know there is always a way to do it. Consider the lingerie behemoth Victoria’s Secret, which plays classical music in its stores to make clients feel as though they are part of an exclusive shopping experience. According to a 2018 survey by Mood Media, 75 percent of customers will stay in a business if they love the music. 4. Create Touch Appealing To The Senses Touch is a powerful sensation that most companies can quickly capitalize on. There is almost always a method for your brand to benefit from texture. This may be choosing substantial, high-quality card paper for your postal adverts. Or going above and above to ensure your items feel lovely in the customer’s hand. Whatever method you use, make sure that you are not neglecting this critical sensory opportunity in your marketing. 5. Make Sense Marketing Visually Appealing Of course, sight is one of the most potent senses in the world of advertising. Fortunately, it’s also one of the most superficial marketing senses to master. To emphasize the importance of sight, ensure that your company’s website is visually appealing to clients, or employ an expert to create your social media or advertising visuals. Color is an essential component of sight, and companies such as Coca-Cola and Virgin Airlines have used color to build brand awareness for their goods. The logos of these companies are instantly recognizable all across the world. If you don’t already have a color scheme for your company, now is a great time to create one. Hire a professional web design company if you don’t feel comfortable doing it on your own. Since color says so much about your brand, this is one marketing step that’s well worth investing in. Wrapping Up – Sensory Marketing Know-How 5 Senses Marketing Works Best for Businesses Now you can imagine how sensory appeal or 5 senses marketing is, right? Hopefully, it is a yes. With these basic ideas and strategies, you can help other folks seeking which approach they can apply to their business. Even you can inspire your readers to continue returning to your website and obtain more traffic by applying the perfect sensory appeal indeed. Remember that business owners’ main marketing tactic is word of mouth. If you can spread the word and show your authenticity, you can win the market quickly as one of the perfect sensory marketing brands. And the suitable 5 senses marketing agency can take your business another level up! Another thing, creativity lies in you.
